decisions.reason: The existing message-750 MODIFY already moves the panel power control to the integrated board and removes the obsolete interboard PWRON tap while preserving the external panel-button connector.
The single-board decision does not change any confirmed GPIO assignment or compatibility policy.
The existing event recognizes the integrated board but incorrectly retains obsolete MAIN_BOARD and POWER_BOARD scope contexts.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I was thinking, if you have time for a new project and are willing to do it, that we try to make as cheap as possible single board for this project. So everything will be on one board and from start we try to match JLCPCB Basica component (as much as possible). It will have much less connectors as there are no interboard connectors. Also if you have some idea on how to make something better/cheaper but have same functionality you can suggest. I can add it as new milestone to this project and we can agree on price. What do you think does it make sense?

decisions.reason: The existing message-750 MODIFY already records the JLCPCB Basic-component preference and integrated-board sourcing scope without stale board-specific attributes.

Combining the boards does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module model, variant, part number, or pin count.
The existing event changes scope to the integrated board but leaves obsolete 5V and enable interboard connector routes in state despite the explicit removal of interboard connectors.
